name: Channel Requests
description: Lets non-admins request new channels for admin approval, with configurable naming rules and automatic member add.

settings_schema.header:
## Channel Requests

Lets non-admins **request** channels instead of creating them directly. Requests are posted to the approval channel below; System Admins (and optionally Team Admins / group members) can approve or deny.

Set the approval team + channel first. Then configure domain prefixes so channels follow your naming convention automatically.

settings.help_text: Dropdown of teams you're a member of. Pick the team containing your approval channel.
Dropdown of channels in the selected team. Pick the channel where new channel requests get posted for approval.

Structured editor: define allowed channel prefixes (team-, project-, etc.) with descriptions and suffix rules. Requesters pick from a dropdown; the resulting channel URL is prefix+suffix. Includes preset packs for common org shapes and a live preview.
Only used when the prefixes editor above is empty. Use {{name}} as a placeholder for the slugified requester name.
Only used when the prefixes editor above is empty. Regex the final channel URL must match; anchor with ^ and $.
When enabled, Team Admins of the approval team can click Approve/Deny in addition to System Admins.

settings.display_name: Channel Admins of the approval channel can approve requests
settings.help_text: When enabled, Channel Admins of the approval channel can click Approve/Deny in addition to System Admins. Useful when a specific team's leads own the approval flow.

settings.placeholder: One MM user ID per line, or comma-separated.
settings.help_text: Requests from these users bypass approval and create the channel immediately. Useful for delegated managers. IDs are 26 characters; invalid lines are ignored.

settings.display_name: Post a welcome message in the created channel
settings.help_text: When enabled, the bot posts a short welcome in the newly-created channel citing who requested it and who approved.
When set, every approve/deny action logs a message to this channel. Useful for compliance.

settings.display_name: Max requests per user per window
settings.help_text: Rate limit: max requests a single user can submit per window. 0 = unlimited.
Rolling window for the rate limit above. Defaults to 24.
